_doc: Acceptance targets for tools/regress/run_regression.py. Values and sources from docs/SPEC_SHEET.md. Tolerances were fixed on 2026-11-02 BEFORE the first run (master plan section 2.2) so they cannot be tuned to the result.
_tolerance_note: ESTIMATE, chosen by Claude pending Nik's review. hard_point 3 mm: the model was built from these numbers, so it should match almost exactly. overall 10 mm: about 2 pixels of a 500 px/m drawing, and the spread between the GA front and rear views.
_frame: model frame: car faces -Y, Z up, +X car left, origin on the ground midway between the axles, unloaded tyres. Overall width excludes door mirrors. Body set excludes tyres, rims, discs and mirrors.

targets.src: FIA p2, measured at the front wing behind the axle
